action_inputs.description: Azure environment to create the resource group in. Lists environments entitled to your group plus Unconstrained environments (no group restriction). Gates resource-handler access for RBAC and supplies the region (node_location) and subscription.
action_inputs.label: Environment
action_inputs.name: env_id

action_inputs.description: Name of the new resource group: 1-90 characters of alphanumerics, underscores, parentheses, hyphens, or periods. May not end with a period.
action_inputs.label: Resource Group Name
action_inputs.name: resource_group_name

action_inputs.description: Optional additional Azure tags, one key=value per line (commas also accepted). Governance tags are generated automatically from the resource handler's tag map (Taggable Attributes) and take precedence over these on a name conflict. Example: costcenter=1234
action_inputs.label: Additional Tags
action_inputs.name: rg_tags

description: Build plugin: creates an Azure Resource Group via the Azure Resource Manager SDK. Region and subscription come from the selected Environment. Tags are the union of the tag-map tags generated by the shared plugin OHK-xoajww7v (read from the Resource custom field cb_generated_tags) and any additional key=value tags entered on the order form; generated tags win on a name conflict and Azure tag limits are enforced.
name: Azure Resource Group
